no-restricted-syntax.message: Do not append a hex alpha byte to a design token. The tokens in theme/tokens.js are `var(--ava-*)` strings, so `C.red + '14'` produces the literal "var(--ava-red)14" — not a colour, so the browser drops the declaration silently and the tint never renders. Use alpha(C.red, 8) instead, which also makes the tint follow light/dark. See QA-RETEST.md round 13.

Do not append a hex alpha byte to a design token. The tokens in theme/tokens.js are `var(--ava-*)` strings, so `C.red + '14'` produces the literal "var(--ava-red)14" — not a colour, so the browser drops the declaration silently and the tint never renders. Use alpha(C.red, 8) instead, which also makes the tint follow light/dark. See QA-RETEST.md round 13.
Format numbers with formatNumber() / money() from lib/format.js, not toLocaleString(). They pin the locale so every figure reads 44,833 on every machine (round 28).

Do not append a hex alpha byte to a colour variable: if it holds a design token (`var(--ava-*)`) the result is not a colour and the tint never renders. Use alpha(color, pct) from theme/tokens.js (round 28).

Do not append a hex alpha byte to a colour (any expression + '14'): design tokens are `var(--ava-*)` strings, so the result is not a colour and the tint never renders. Use alpha(color, pct) from theme/tokens.js (round 28).
